name: Signal Fire Stack
description: Stack firewood and green boughs into a signal pyre on high ground.

crit_success.message: Perfect cone — smoke by day, flame by night. (Placement is the task-703 executor's job; the pyre spawns carried until then.)

fail.message: Damp-laid — slow to light, but stacked.

crit_fail.message: Scattered stack — restack it, nothing lost.
